protocol_type: LoRaWAN MAC frame protocol over the LoRa CSS PHY. The PHY transports a frame (preamble + sync word + header + payload + CRC) modulated as Chirp Spread Spectrum; the MAC frame inside is MHDR | MACPayload | MIC, with MAC commands managing the link.

phy_frame_structure.description: Programmable number of up-chirps (default 8) for detection/synchronization.
2.25 down-chirps marking the end of the preamble.
Payload length, coding rate, header CRC; omitted in implicit-header mode.

mac_frame_format.FHDR: DevAddr (4 B) | FCtrl (1 B) | FCnt (2 B) | FOpts (0-15 B)
mac_frame_format.MIC_meaning: AES-128-CMAC over the frame keyed by NwkSKey

mac_commands.name: LinkCheckReq/Ans
mac_commands.purpose: Device asks for link margin and gateway count.

mac_commands.name: LinkADRReq/Ans
mac_commands.purpose: Server sets data rate (SF), TX power, and channel mask.

mac_commands.name: DutyCycleReq/Ans
mac_commands.purpose: Server sets the device's maximum duty cycle.

mac_commands.name: RXParamSetupReq/Ans
mac_commands.purpose: Server sets RX1DROffset, RX2 data rate, RX2 frequency.

mac_commands.name: DevStatusReq/Ans
mac_commands.purpose: Server asks for battery level and demodulation margin.

mac_commands.name: NewChannelReq/Ans
mac_commands.purpose: Server defines or modifies a channel.

mac_commands.name: TxParamSetupReq/Ans
mac_commands.purpose: Server sets max EIRP and dwell time.

activation_procedures.OTAA: Join-Request (DevEUI, JoinEUI, DevNonce) -> Join-Accept (DevAddr, settings, AppNonce); derive NwkSKey + AppSKey from AppKey.
activation_procedures.ABP: DevAddr, NwkSKey, AppSKey pre-provisioned; no join exchange.

frame_counter.role: incremented per frame, included in the MIC, checked for replay (must increase).

addressing.note: DevEUI is the globally unique IEEE EUI-64; DevAddr is the 32-bit network-local address assigned at join.
